# Sojib Ahmmed

> Sojib Ahmmed — Founder & CEO, MarketSync Global. Operator and builder.

Sojib Ahmmed is the Founder & CEO of MarketSync Global LLC (US) and MarketSync Global Ltd. (Bangladesh).
